decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I prioritized speakers with a balance of high power output (30W) and portability for outdoor use. My consideration set included the TENMIYA 30W and the Comiso 30W for their impressive specs at a lower price point. I also evaluated the JBL Charge 4 and Flip 5 renewed models; while JBL is a premium brand, the 'renewed' status and associated reviews regarding battery longevity caused some hesitation. The INSMY Retro was considered for its unique aesthetic and high quality reviews. Ultimately, I chose the Comiso 30W because it offers a 4.5-star rating, IPX7 waterproofing, and high-wattage sound for under $40, representing the best value for performance.
